passives.name: Terminal: Protect Weakness
passives.description: Damage taken from Strikers increases by [Buff_V_singularity_passive_ks_a_1], and damage taken increases by 25% for each Water enemy. If there are no Defenders on the enemy team, all skills deal fixed damage equal to 20% of the target's current HP before attacking. Damage from Cursed and fixed damage taken by Bosses cannot exceed 50,000.
